_r13b_note: R13 snapshot of the extended grouping, written before the NIST mds2-3402 addition was integrated: it describes the 24-point / six-source dataset and does NOT contain mds2-3402. The R13b leave-one-source run that includes mds2-3402 (54 points, seven sources, nist_mds2_3402 = 30 points, leave-one-source error 61.35%) is recorded in ../output/experiment_v13b_mds2_loso_results.json. No value in this file has been altered.
protocol: Extended protocol for the LPBF tensile-fracture dataset. This is an INDEPENDENT protocol: the v12 nine points are reproduced verbatim (source_id = v12_original) and are NOT modified; the extended statistics are reported separately and must not be silently substituted for the v12 statistics.
orientation_convention: 0 deg = loading axis PARALLEL to the build direction (BD), 90 deg = PERPENDICULAR to BD, 45 deg = inclined. Sources reporting the angle from the build PLATE are converted (plate 0 -> 90, plate 90 -> 0); ASTM Z/X specimen codes need no conversion.
